standalone_mode_safety_analysis.question: Will getSpecialLocation(currentExecutableFile).getParentDirectory() return SAME path in standalone vs VST plugin mode?
reasoning: In VST plugin mode: currentExecutableFile = path/to/plugin.dll
Both will have .getParentDirectory() pointing to the application directory
The 'Program Files' detection will work in both modes

task_2_modal_loop_elimination.title: Modal Loop Conversion to enterModalState() - Behavioral Equivalence
task_2_modal_loop_elimination.summary: LicenseActivationDialog::showModal() has JUCE_MODAL_LOOPS_PERMITTED guard. Converting runModalLoop() to enterModalState()+ModalCallbackFunction is behaviorally equivalent. Only ONE runModalLoop() exists in codebase.

setup: Line 127-137: Set up onValidated/onQuit callbacks that call exitModalState()

what_runModalLoop_does: Returns the value passed to exitModalState()
Processes events on message thread while blocked
Window is visible during blocking period
user_interaction_flow: 3. User clicks button (sign in or quit)

behavioral_equivalence.window_visibility: IDENTICAL - window shown in both cases
behavioral_equivalence.return_value: IDENTICAL - callback receives same value from exitModalState()
behavioral_equivalence.blocking_vs_async: DIFFERENT - enterModalState is non-blocking, but callback invoked with SAME result
behavioral_equivalence.application_logic: IDENTICAL - callback can return same result to caller via stored promise/callback

key_difference.enterModalState: Asynchronous - callback receives value, must propagate result
key_difference.solution: Wrap showModal() result in a callback or promise, or return from callback to caller

enterModalState_usage.pattern: All other dialogs already use enterModalState() pattern - they're async and work fine

juce_modal_loops_permitted_usage.current_fallback: Without guard: just shows window, returns 0 (failure)
